info.name: Caiyun Weather Air Quality Realtime API

params.name: token
params.description: Caiyun Weather API token issued by the Open Platform (platform.caiyunapp.com). Embedded in the path rather than a header.

params.name: lnglat
params.description: Longitude,latitude tuple as `lng,lat` (note the order — longitude first). Use WGS84 decimal degrees.

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit system for numeric values (temperature, wind, precipitation, pressure).

items.docs: Returns the current weather conditions at the requested location — temperature, humidity, wind, cloud cover, sky condition (skycon), visibility, downward shortwave radiation, pressure, apparent temperature, precipitation, air quality, and life indices.
